4.heading: That which the palmerworm hath left:
refs: Heb. The residue of the palmer-worm, Joel 2:25

The learned Bochart, and others, are of the opinion that the four Hebrew words, gazam, yelek, arbeh, chasil, respectively rendered the palmer-worm, locust, canker-worm and caterpillar, denote four different species of locusts. See note on Exod 10:4
4.body:

12.heading: The vine:
refs: Dr. Shaw observes, that in Barbary, in the month of June the locusts are no sooner hatched than they collect themselves into compact bodies, each a "furlong or more square
and marching directly after they are come to life, make their way towards the sea and let nothing escape them, eating up everything that is green or juicy
not only the lesser vegetables, but the vine likewise, the fig-tree, the pomegranate, the palm, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field." Joel 1:10
12.body:
